summary: Iter 3 Evolution API integration verified. Backend endpoints and webhook receiver all functional. Evolution API IS reachable from sandbox - real base64 QR code returned on connect.
passed: Super admin login + tenant creation (with admin_name field)
GET /api/whatsapp/status returns new fields (evolution_instance_name, evolution_instance_token, last_webhook_event_at) defaulting to null and status=desconectado when never connected
GET /api/whatsapp/connection legacy alias returns same row

POST /api/whatsapp/connect returned 200 with status=pareando, qrcode_atual populated (data:image/png;base64,...), evolution_instance_name=zappzen_7da52de8aed84bd1 (first 16 chars of tenant_id without hyphens), token=hash from Evolution
POST /api/whatsapp/disconnect returns row with status=desconectado, qrcode_atual=null, numero=null
Legacy POST /api/whatsapp/connection {action:'confirm_paired'} returns current status row
Webhook POST /api/webhooks/evolution/{unknown} returns 404 Tenant não configurado
Webhook connection.update state=open with matching instance returns 200 {ok:true}
Webhook instance mismatch returns 403 Instance mismatch
Webhook messages.upsert with fromMe=false + conversation queues background task returns {ok:true, queued:1}
notes: Evolution API was reachable during this test (200 with real QR PNG base64). 502 fallback branch not exercised because service was up. Legacy testids and UI toast/QR display not asserted via Playwright due to token budget — page load HTTP 200 confirmed.
